entities.summary: Sumi Jo (b. 1962-11-22, Changwon) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Changwon and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
